findings.title: Italian text used as the Lithuanian translation of totpStep1
findings.body: The old Lithuanian `totpStep1` (with FreeOTP/Google Play links) was replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`. That is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence on the account TOTP setup page. The line should either be a proper Lithuanian translation of "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:" or be removed so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Italian text used as the Lithuanian translation of loginTotpStep1
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` was changed to `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. The Lithuanian login OTP setup screen will show an Italian instruction. Use a real Lithuanian translation or drop the key so the English default is used.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text inserted into the Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) bundle
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` is `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`, which is Traditional Chinese (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). It is in the zh_CN bundle, where the rest of the file is Simplified. Simplified-Chinese users will see mixed scripts. It should read something like `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.

findings.title: i18next {{n}} placeholders replaced with Java MessageFormat {n} and choice syntax in a JS UI bundle
findings.body: This file uses i18next-style `{{0}}`/`{{1}}` placeholders (see the neighbouring `error-invalid-length-too-short='{{0}}' must have minimal length of {{1}}.`). The PR rewrote `error-invalid-multivalued-size` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. i18next does not interpolate single-brace `{0}` and does not support `choice` formatting. The message will probably render literally with raw `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and the choice expression. The old `{{0}}` form worked with the UI's interpolation. Only the server-side bundles under `themes/` should use MessageFormat choice syntax; the JS bundle should keep `{{n}}` and avoid `choice`, for example a plain "value(s)".

findings.title: Admin UI bundle switched from i18next {{n}} to MessageFormat {n} and choice syntax
findings.body: The admin-ui bundle is rendered by i18next, like the account-ui one, and its sibling `error-*` keys use `{{0}}`. `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed to single-brace `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` plus `{2,choice,...}`. i18next will not substitute the parameters or evaluate the choice, so the validation error shown to admins is likely to contain raw placeholders. Keep the `{{n}}` form here and do not use `choice`.

findings.title: Diff-snippet computation can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of reporting the error
findings.body:
The common prefix (`start`) and common suffix (`end`) are computed independently and are not bounded so that `start + end <= min(length)`. If the removed fragment shares boundary characters with its neighbours, the two ranges overlap. Example: `

A

B

` where the disallowed `` sits between a `>` and a `<`. Then `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` has start > end and throws. The verifier would crash with an unchecked exception rather than emit the "Illegal HTML" message, hiding the real problem. Clamp `end` to `min(value.length(), sanitized.length()) - start`.

findings.title: English reference file lookup is fragile: unchecked exception or silent self-comparison
findings.body: The English file is derived by regex on the whole absolute path. If no `_en` counterpart exists, a `RuntimeException` is thrown from `verify()`, which declares `MojoExecutionException`, so the build fails with a raw stack trace. If the file name does not match `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` (for example a locale suffix containing digits, or a file without a locale), the 'English' file resolves to the file being checked. In that case the translation is compared against itself and the check that only the English source's HTML/anchors may appear is silently bypassed. Fail with a clear MojoExecutionException when the English file is missing or cannot be derived.
